# tool result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:toolResult`](gmeow-toolResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/toolResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/agentic`](../../slices/agentic.md)

The verbatim result payload the tool returned, byte-faithful — the PAYLOAD of the event, never a forward entity link: an entity the call produced links back via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)). For large payloads store a content digest literal instead ('blake3:…'), as [`gmeow:toolArguments`](gmeow-toolArguments.md). Functional: one result record per call.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ToolCall`](../classes/gmeow-ToolCall.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:toolResult`](gmeow-toolResult.md) from [`gmeow:ToolCall`](../classes/gmeow-ToolCall.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    rdfs:label "turn 7, call 1: search"@en ;

    gmeow:toolArguments "{\"query\": \"GTS deterministic encoding spec\"}" ;

    gmeow:usedTool ex:storeClaim ;
    gmeow:toolArguments "{\"text\": \"the GTS spec mandates RFC 8949 deterministic encoding\"}" ;
